junk_imagery.evidence: No stock or AI photos. Every frame uses flat icons: carts in seg0 and seg1, worker emoji on the scale in seg2. At seg4:end (f20) two stray cyan ellipse outlines appear over the circles; that is a render glitch, not junk imagery.

decorative_mascot.evidence: In seg0 and seg1 Data stands on a ladder beside the 92% bar and points at it, but the bar grows by itself. At seg2:start he is parked half off the left edge of the scale. From seg3:start to seg4:end he just stands on top of the 4% circle. He never causes any of the motion.

bare_number_card.evidence: In seg3 and seg4 the 4% vs 1.6% loss rate is two flat circles with a number in each (seg3:end). Nothing shows a loss happening.

dead_air.evidence: seg1:start, seg1:mid and seg1:end (4.9-8.4s) are the same finished bar chart already shown at seg0:end. Only Data's arms change, so two beats look identical for about 6 seconds.

empty_void.evidence: In seg3:start the two small circles float in a mostly empty dark frame, and the labels 'Self-checkout' and 'Staffed checkout' sit far below them, cut off from their marks. In seg0 and seg1 the top 40% of the frame is empty above the bars.

unreadable.evidence: In seg2:start, mid and end Data's body covers the '3' of '3.5M', so it reads '.5M', and he is cropped at the left edge. In seg3:mid the big caption number shows '4%' and '1.6%' drawn on top of each other, so it reads '146%'. In seg3:start the '4%' is half hidden under Data. In seg2:mid the caption '3.5' is dark purple on navy and nearly invisible.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg3:start through seg3:end show a pink 4% circle and a grey 1.6% circle on an empty dark ground. Data stands on top of the pink circle doing nothing. The labels drift far below the circles, and the caption at seg3:mid overlaps into '146%'.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The 'loss rate' comparison was drawn as a stock pair of sized circles. Nothing in the picture is made of shoplifting or shrink, and the mascot is parked as a sticker instead of causing the motion.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Redraw the loss as the subject itself. Show two checkout lanes where items slip off the belt or out of a bagging area into a loss bin: 4 of every 100 at the self-checkout lane, 1.6 at the staffed one. Data should be at the self-checkout scanner and miss the scans, so the loss pile grows because of him. Keep labels attached to their lanes, and make the caption number swap cleanly instead of overlapping.

depictions.note: A plain bar chart of adoption (6/33/92%) with cart icons on the bars. The hook line says 92% of cashier jobs were 'wiped out', but the bars show adoption.
The same finished bar chart held for the whole beat. Nothing new is shown.
A stock seesaw with worker emoji dropped onto each pan. The tilt is barely visible, so the drop from 3.5M to 3M doesn't come across.
Two sized circles labelled 4% and 1.6%. It is a bubble chart in all but name.
The closing reuses the circles under the closing line, with stray cyan ellipses added at the end.

grades.one_line: Three stock charts with Data standing beside them. The hook claims '92% of cashier jobs wiped out', but the 92% on screen is self-checkout adoption, and the beat after the hook repeats the hook's chart.
problems: The hook claim 'wiped out 92% of cashier jobs' doesn't match the data shown: 92% is the share of grocery chains with self-checkout lanes, and jobs fell only from 3.5M to 3M.
In seg1 the whole beat is the bar chart already finished at seg0:end, so the frame looks unchanged for about 6s.
In seg2 the mascot covers the '3' of '3.5M' and is cut off at the left edge of the frame.
In seg3:mid the caption numbers overlap into '146%'.
seg3 and seg4 are two plain circles with numbers in them, and the labels float far from the circles.
Data stands, perches or points in every scene and never drives the motion.
At seg4:end stray cyan ellipse outlines appear over both circles.
fixes: Rewrite the hook so it states the real claim, for example that 92% of big grocers now have self-checkout, or show the 500k lost jobs.
Replace the seg1 chart with a scene made of the subject: a store's checkout lanes turning into kiosks one by one until 92 of 100 have them, with Data installing each kiosk.
In seg2, move Data off the 3.5M label and have him lift cashiers off one pan so the scale visibly tips.
Redraw seg3 as items slipping through unscanned at a self-checkout lane into a loss pile, 4 vs 1.6 per 100, with Data as the scanner.
Fix the caption crossfade so two numbers are never drawn on top of each other.
Remove the stray cyan ellipses at the end.
